checks.name: typecheck + lint across the whole slice
checks.command: npx tsc -b; npx eslint <all changed files>

findings: shared/json-budget.ts treats an `undefined` value as unusable, so a TS object that spells an omitted optional field as `undefined` was reported as PACKAGE_BUDGET. Fixed by probing the JSON view of the package (which is what the store and the hash see) and keeping jsonWithinBudget semantics unchanged for wire values.

The frame needs `unsafe-eval` in its own CSP to instantiate compiled modules; the host CSP is untouched and the frame has an opaque origin with no cookie/storage/network (verified in the browser harness).

The bridge parser rejected messages containing `undefined` optional fields because jsonWithinBudget treats undefined as unusable; fixed by probing the JSON view on both the package and the message path, and by omitting absent fields when the host replies.
HTML5 drag-and-drop cannot be driven reliably by pointer emulation; the fixture uses pointer events, which is also the correct behaviour for touch and keyboard.

Independent review FAILED the candidate and found real defects; fixed in the follow-up commit: (a) a projection update arriving before the frame mounted was dropped — ports are now re-sent on frame load; (b) an inline `presentation={{…}}` remounted the frame on every parent render — the effect now depends on primitive fields; (c) a write declaration could target an `out` port — rejected now; (d) a behaviour module importing a pinned library passed validation and failed only in the isolate — all imports are rejected now; (e) the SDK promise could hang when the host dropped a message — intents now settle as abandoned on timeout and on the pending cap; (f) my own fixture encoded the wrong behaviour ABI (`{changes}` instead of a bare list).

Reviewer findings still OPEN (do not mark PASS): ISO-01 must be re-run from an http origin (downgraded to UNVERIFIED); the behaviour runner needs `behaviorId` + package-derived declared writes and must read `request.expected`, otherwise TOOL_STALE_REVISION/TOOL_SOURCE_REVOKED are unreachable; spec.md has no F080 entry yet; the frame runtime is ~685 KB inlined per instance and undocumented; the 64 KiB bridge bound is only enforced for string payloads; no CI job runs the tool-host harness; several declared limits/rejection codes are unenforced.

checks.name: single authoring pipeline (human + AI) with pre-dispatch budget and isolated trial
checks.evidence: 12/12: an over-budget estimate never calls the generator (the spy generator is never entered); no generator or no budget fails closed; validation → compile → trial → activation for both routes; one repair attempt receives the previous diagnostics; a trial failure blocks activation and keeps the problems; an unchanged hand edit is rejected as NO_CHANGE; the AI route is handed the person-edited base version, not the original

findings: Budget enforcement is now structural rather than a log line: the generator is only reachable through a function that refuses when the estimate exceeds the remaining cap, which is what the paid-AI gate requires before any live call.

checks.name: collaboration space contract: role×verb matrix, source-link invariants, commands, reader compatibility
checks.evidence: 21/21: matrix keeps administration to the manager; a participant can run but not author/rebind; no space role can decide a source grant; export needs a separate unexpired grant; membership alone never reads a source; addMember/setRole/transferManager leave sources byte-identical; a second manager is refused; leaving marks the link `left` instead of deleting history; reader tolerates absent/old/newer schema and skips only the unreadable entries

checks.name: collaboration space storage path without a migration
checks.command: npx vitest run src/tabletop/domain/collaboration-space.test.ts; npx vitest run src/tabletop
checks.evidence: 9/9: a workspace that never had a space reads as {space: undefined, problems: []}; create makes the owner the single manager and bumps actionRevision; addMember leaves `sources` byte-identical; leaveSource marks `left` instead of deleting; JSON round-trip is unchanged; a newer space schema is reported without discarding the workspace. Full src suite 801/801 shows the TableState addition regressed nothing.

findings: The plan matrix has no "grant a source" verb at all — encoded as an absence in SPACE_VERBS plus a test that asserts it, so a future verb addition fails the test rather than widening access silently.

No strict schema guards stored domain state (no domainStateSchema/tableStateSchema in server/; it is read back through parseJsonValue), so the space can live as an optional field on the hosting workspace — the same additive shape notes/cardMeta used. That removes the D1 migration this slice was gated on.

Encoding incident: PowerShell Add-Content/Set-Content rewrote decisions.md double-encoded (243 U+FFFD) and it reached a commit; repaired by restoring the last valid blob and rewriting through the editor tool. A strict-UTF-8 + mojibake scan now runs before commit (MEMORY.md records the rule).
